)-farnesyl diphosphate lyase (cyclizing; (+)-α-santalene-forming)

This enzyme
catalyses
the following
chemical reaction
(2
Z
,6
Z
)-farnesyl diphosphate

{\displaystyle \rightleftharpoons }

diphosphate
The enzyme synthesizes a mixture of
sesquiterpenoids
from (2Z,6Z)-farnesyl diphosphate.
